intent.outcome: brew outdated (formula+cask) runs lazily when Outdated is first selected (or Status needs it), coalesces concurrent callers, and respects a configurable TTL (default 30m) so navigation/refresh does not stampede Homebrew.

problem.description: Init and RefreshMsg always fetch Outdated with every panel. Cache TTL is a single 30s on the client. Concurrent Status dashboard + panel fetch can double-call before cache fills. No singleflight; no outdated-specific TTL; not lazy.

in_scope: Lazy load: do not call Formulae.Outdated/Casks.Outdated on Init unless Outdated (or Status dashboard path that needs counts) is active — pick one policy and document: preferred = skip on Init; Status uses cache or lightweight path.
Request coalescing (singleflight) for outdated formula and cask fetches inside brew layer or GUI fetch.
Configurable TTL: e.g. brew.outdated_ttl or cache.outdated_ttl duration (default 30m); wire into cache Get/Set or dedicated stale check.
RefreshMsg should not force outdated re-fetch if within TTL unless user is on Outdated panel and presses R (document behavior).
Unit tests: coalescing (1 brew call for 2 concurrent), lazy (0 calls before panel select), TTL config parse default.
out_of_scope: Combining formula+cask into one brew outdated invocation (optional later).

findings.description: Lazy-fetch logic is duplicated across switchPanel, nextPanel, prevPanel (3 callsites). Extract a helper m.lazyLoadOutdated() tea.Cmd to centralize the 'items == nil && !loading' check + err reset + cmd return. Low priority since each callsite is 4 lines, but a future bug-fix (e.g., new lazy-loaded panel) would need 3 places.
findings.author: runner

findings.description: Status dashboard outdated count does not auto-refresh after user visits Outdated panel. fetchStatusData runs only on Init and RefreshMsg. After the user first visits Outdated (cache fills) and navigates back to Status, the dashboard still shows 0 until the user presses R or auto-refresh fires. Documented as 'user must press R' but slightly suboptimal. Could be fixed by firing fetchStatusData after a successful Outdated fetch (singleflight would coalesce the redundant call). Out of M9 scope; recommend follow-up.
findings.author: runner

findings.description: RefreshMsg sets m.refreshing=6 always, but only enqueues 5 cmds when activePanel != Outdated (Formulae, Casks, Taps, Services, Status). Each DataLoadedMsg decrements refreshing; toast 'Data refreshed' fires only at 0. With 5 msgs, refreshing sticks at 1 and the success toast never appears after R (unless user is on Outdated). Fix: set refreshing = len(cmds) after building the batch (or 5 vs 6 explicitly). Add TestRefreshToastWhenOutdatedInactive.
findings.author: coordinator
findings.summary: RefreshMsg refreshing=6 stuck when Outdated not fetched

findings.description: singleflight.Do runs fn() then wg.Done()+delete without defer. If fn panics, waiters block forever on wg.Wait and the key stays in inflight. Use defer for Done+delete (x/sync/singleflight pattern).
